fields.description: The workbook (BOQs) the edited row belongs to. Denormalized, as on BoQ Row BCS Rate.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The committed sheet name, stored VERBATIM (#152 -- never stripped).
fields.label: Sheet Name

fields.description: The source Excel row the edit belongs to (= BOQ Nodes.source_row_number). Per ROW: the edit is shared by every view of the row's rate helper (Supply, Install, Combined, BCS supply), so there is no column.
fields.label: Excel Row

fields.description: The committed version the edit was made on. A new committed version reads NO edit of an older one (users copy rates to the next version explicitly).
fields.label: Committed Version

fields.description: The row's effective category when the edit was saved. A record of context only; nothing branches on it.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: {attr_id: {value, from_kind, by, at}} for every key the rate helper's setAttr takes (plain attributes and the JSON keys __items__, __shares__, __row_unit__, __row_qty__, __includes__, __scope__). from_kind = the view the edit was made in: supply / install / combined / bcs_supply. ONLY the helper's inputs: a typed final value, a cell's rate and a BCS cost are never stored here, and nothing here writes them.
fields.label: Edits

fields.description: Per-(boq, sheet_name, excel_row, committed_version) version, max prior + 1 on every save (freeze-and-supersede, as BoQ Row BCS Rate.bcs_version). A record is never overwritten in place.
fields.label: Edit Version

fields.description: Exactly one current record per (boq, sheet_name, excel_row, committed_version), enforced by the write path (api/boq/wizard/helper_edits.py), not this controller. The prior current is frozen with frappe.db.set_value(is_current=0); clearing every key ends the row's current record.
fields.label: Is Current

fields.description: When the latest save was written.
fields.label: Edited At
